reason: The research target is the CSI1000 index open gap, not a directly executable fill.
The index level 000852.SH is not itself a tradable instrument price.
A prediction of the opening gap does not by itself define a realizable PnL path; an order filled at the open cannot retroactively capture the already-realized previous-close-to-open gap.

The US overnight features are causally available before the China open, but the financial action that consumes the prediction still needs an explicit tradable instrument, decision time, order/fill rule and post-signal economic objective.
Account or return optimization before those semantics are frozen would answer a different financial question and could feed trading outcomes back into the already-accepted prediction model.
